newsitem.title: USA: California Carl's Jr to buy Hardee's chain - paper.
newsitem.headline: California Carl's Jr to buy Hardee's chain - paper.

text.p: The owner of California-based Carl's Jr. restaurants, bidding to become one of the largest U.S. fast-food chains, has agreed to buy the 3,100-outlet Hardee's for $325 million, the Los Angeles Times reported in its Monday editions.
Through the acquisition of Hardee's, CKE Restaurants Inc. would acquire outlets in 41 states and about 10 foreign countries, the newspaper said, quoting sources.
Hardee's is the fourth-largest hamburger chain in the United States, behind McDonald's, Burger King and Wendy's, the report said.

The paper said the deal has been rumored for months amog restaurant industry observers, who speculated that CKE would use the North Carolina-based Hardee's as a springboard to a national role for the 675-unit Carl's Jr. chain in southern California.
Hardee's is owned by Montreal-based Imasco Ltd., and includes about 800 company-owned and 2,300 franchise-operated restaurants, the paper said.
The newspaper said the deal would be announced early on Monday.
There was no immediate comment from the restaurant chains or the parent companies.
